messages.author: 5a91d3696b12d600
messages.subject: discretizing transects
parts:
I am trying to discretize some transects: 

>traps2020_sess1_25m<-snip(traps2020_sess1, by =25, keep.incomplete = TRUE)

>traps2020_sess1_25m <-reduce(traps2020_sess1_25m, outputdetector = 'proximity')

 

But when we do so we get the following warning after the snip operation:

Warning message:

In slice(object, from = from, by = by, length.out = length.out,  :

  NAs introduced by coercion

And the resulting object are “transect” not “proximity” detector types

 

Has anyone run into this issue before?

Thanks!

Joe

messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: Re: discretizing transects
parts:
Hi Joe

I think you've hit a recent bug - sorry about that. I have fixed it, at least temporarily, in a provisional version of secr available at secr_4.4.6.zip (Windows binary) or secr_4.4.6.tar.gz (source).

The problem should have showed up in secr-polygondetectors.pdf, but maybe escaped detection because I didn't delete an old cache. Do let me know if there are further problems.

Murray
